newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.507 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.507 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of July 14 were expected to total $2.507 billion in 122 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.780 billion in 47 sales, with a $350 million Los Angeles Unified School District offering through BancAmerica topping the list.
On the competitive side, 75 sales totaling $727 million are scheduled. A $78.5 million Virginia HDA offering on July 17 is the largest.
For Monday, July 14, 13 competitive issues totaling $54 million are slated for sale.
An additional four sales totaling $357 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues during the week depending on market conditions.
